inspection_scope: Independent-variant review of t01 and t02 using the supplied ordered decoded frames, both caption modes, all 13 consecutive frames around each declared contact, and the supplied pixel-change observations. Each variant was assessed only against its own declared before/after, purpose, performance, and focal target.

gates.evidence: t01 communicates a modest lift and sustained presentation of the source paper. In t02, however, the paper separates from Bot immediately after the declared contact, travels independently, and then returns, so the painted progression reads as release/recapture rather than a controlled lift-and-inspect action.

t01 keeps the paper aligned with the raised hand, making Bot's lift a credible cause of its upward change. In t02 frames 91–93 (3.033–3.100s), the hand and paper separate without a depicted release or other cause; the paper subsequently returns to the grip, breaking the causal chain.
In both caption modes and both variants, the bright labeled paper beside Bot's raised arm is the clearest action object. The plant and caption area do not displace it as the focal detail.

t01 preserves the identities and spatial relationships of Bot, paper, plant, wall, and floor through its ending. t02 breaks the persistent held-paper relationship after contact: the paper jumps to the far right, then leftward above the hand, and finally reattaches, despite the declared ending that it remains held.

violations.observation: Immediately after the declared contact, the source paper is visibly detached far to the right of Bot's open hand. Subsequent frames move it independently before it returns, changing the intended lift-and-inspect beat into an unexplained throw/recapture.
violations.smallest_correction: Keep the paper attached to the hand throughout the lift and settle so the final raised hold develops directly from the opening lower position.

violations.observation: The hand no longer anchors the paper in frames 91–93; no visible release, force, or handoff explains the paper's independent displacement and return.
violations.smallest_correction: Remove the independent paper translation after contact and resolve its position from the moving hand/grip anchor on every frame.

violations.observation: The persistent source paper changes from held to unheld and then back to held across consecutive native frames, contradicting the declared continuous raised hold.
violations.smallest_correction: Preserve one identifiable paper and continuous hand attachment from the contact frame through the ending.

sampling_limits: Assessment is based on supplied still sequences and full-rate pixel-change summaries; no video or audio was watched or heard. The consecutive contact windows establish t01 attachment and the t02 detachment defect, while sparse whole-shot samples establish opening and ending states. Pixel deltas were treated only as change evidence, not semantic motion. Caption and no-caption renders show the same action behavior.

gates.evidence: The paper moves from a lower opening position to a visibly higher position and remains presented at the end; the raised arm, gaze posture, and readable paper make the intended inspection understandable with and without the caption.
Across the consecutive contact window, the paper tracks the raised hand without detaching, so Bot's arm movement visibly causes the lift.
The light paper, its SOURCE label, and the pointing raised arm establish the paper as the dominant explanatory feature at mobile size.
Bot, paper, and plant remain identifiable and spatially coherent; the ending preserves the consequence of the opening lift.

Although the opening and final samples show lower and raised paper states, intermediate truth shows an unexplained detachment and return, so the intended controlled inspection is not a coherent progression.
After contact the paper moves independently of the hand, with no visible cause for either its separation or reattachment.
The source paper remains the dominant action object even during the defective displacement; captions reinforce rather than replace its visibility.
The declared held object loses its grip relationship in frames 91–93 and later snaps back, breaking object and action continuity inside the variant.
